source_caption_text:
This stream was too funny 😭

Via @kaicenat

Nicki Minaj joining Kai Cenat’s stream gave viewers some hilarious moments, starting with Kai jokingly accusing her of trying to kick him in the face during the live stream. He jumped back and shouted, “Nicki, Nicki, Nicki! You just tried to kick me in my face! I thought we were teammates!”

Nicki looked at him and asked, “Why are you making that face?” Kai then tried to smooth things over by complimenting her outfit and saying she smelled good before asking about her perfume, guessing it was her new Pink Friday 2 scent. Nicki simply responded, “I do what the f- I want, okay?”

Kai immediately agreed, replying, “You’re right. Type shit.” It was a hilarious little exchange, with Kai going from jokingly accusing Nicki of trying to kick him to agreeing with everything she said.

#nickiminaj #kaicenat #hiphop
